sql: WITH ai AS (SELECT unit, enabled, to_char(activated_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS ativada, followup_config->>'enabled' AS acompanhamento_ia, test_mode_enabled FROM ai_agent_settings WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'), eli AS (SELECT w.unit, c.contact_name, c.bot_step, c.bot_enabled, c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' AS ai_flag, to_char(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS conversa_criada, (SELECT string_agg(h.action || ' ' || to_char(h.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), ' | ' ORDER BY h.created_at) FROM lead_history h WHERE h.lead_id = c.lead_id AND h.action ILIKE '%follow-up%') AS followups FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = c.lead_id WHERE w.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND (c.contact_name ILIKE '%elizane%' OR l.name ILIKE '%elizane%')) SELECT 'ia' AS tipo, row_to_json(ai)::text AS dados FROM ai UNION ALL SELECT 'elizane', row_to_json(eli)::text FROM eli UNION ALL SELECT 'numeros', string_agg(unit || ' (' || provider || ', ativo=' || is_active::text || ')', ' | ') FROM wapi_instances WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
